options.name: date
options.description: The date as a string in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Used to calculate the current sprint based on the given date.

options.name: name
options.description: The sprint name in the format 'YYYY-NN' where 'NN' is the sprint number. Used to determine the sprint and its details based on the provided name. This module is based on SemSprint with is like SemVer but for sprints see https://c2platform.org/docs/guidelines/project/semsprint/.
